long_biography.plain_text:
Raised on France's Atlantic coast, Martinie de Maisonneuve trained as a marine carpenter before moving to Indonesia in 2009. In Bira, Sulawesi, he worked alongside local shipwrights and developed an approach that joins traditional phinisi construction with modern engineering, comfort and safety. Years of hands-on building and extensive sailing across the archipelago established the craft base for his business.

In 2018, he co-founded Pacific High with Peter and Charlotte Galsgaard. The company combines design and construction at its Bira yard with commercial charter operations and destination services, allowing Martinie de Maisonneuve to oversee projects from concept through launch. As executive chairman, he is expanding the building programme while developing related waterfront hospitality, private aviation and luxury-management services across Asia-Pacific.
